name: Shields & Amulets
pages: Aside from the traditional weapons and armor, there are two more items to bolster your combat prowess: the {i}shield{/} and the {i}pale gold amulet{/}.

pages.text: {i}Shields{/} protect the player from attack damage. When in your {!}main hand{/} or {!}off hand{/}, {i}shields{/} grant a passive {b}15% damage reduction{/}, or {b}80% damage reduction{/} when holding {k:use/k} to block (with a brief cooldown between blocks).{pb}Like most gear, {i}shields{/} can be improved with {l:magic/enchantments/}enchantments{/l}.

The {i}pale gold amulet{/} is a powerful {l:progression/netherite_age/}Netherite Age{/l} item.{pb}When in the player's inventory, it grants the {b}absorption{/} and {b}luck{/} {l:magic/status_effects/}status effects{/l} whenever the player's health drops below 5 hearts, giving you an edge against your opponents.
